name: Xtream Bridge
overview: Xtream Live TV, VOD movies and automatic EPG
description: Xtream-compatible panel integration with separate Live TV and VOD switches, category selection and automatic XMLTV EPG. Targets Jellyfin 12.3. Mock-panel tested; real-server playback not yet verified.

versions.changelog: Filter non-live stream types and on-demand URLs from Live TV and EPG; optionally hide VOD/series categories; hide provider indexes and clean known stream ID prefixes.
Initial release: Live TV, VOD movies, category controls and XMLTV guide.
